exercise.instruction: Write the program: add an int function 'doubleOf' that takes (int n) and returns n * 2, then call it with 21 in main and print the result.
hints: Hint 1: int doubleOf(int n) { return n * 2; } — define it BEFORE main
Hint 2: In main: std::cout << doubleOf(21) << std::endl;
